title: Paralysis
overview: The World has become a feeding ground for Vigilantes as the hospitals fill up with innocent victims to senseless crimes. A new drug called Paralysis has taken over a city that makes the user unusually violent during its high and a feeling of paralysis when coming down. A couple of cops make it their mission to take down the gang before their drug hits the streets any further. Time is ticking because the people of this city are fed up and are now willing to fight back. What will happen first, the cops take down the gang, the paralysis hits the streets creating a bunch of violent addicts, or will vigilante Justice take over. Paralysis is an action thriller with a twist that no one will see coming. All I know for sure is that this powder keg is about to explode in PARALYSIS.
